_readme: This is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for site-wide content and SEO/AI entity data — not fetched by any page at runtime (the site is opened as a local file:// page during review, and browsers block fetch() of local JSON under file://). Edit this file first, then copy the relevant fields into the matching <script type='application/ld+json'> block inside each hub's HTML <head>. Keep the two in sync by hand.

person.name: Nguyễn Thị Thanh Bình
person.bio: A multidisciplinary practitioner who brings the same systems thinking from subsurface engineering into open innovation, and the same care for storytelling into music and video — technical rigor and creative expression treated as one continuous practice, not two separate lives.
